title: Finite adic open extension and fibre data
statement: For every quasi-compact open immersion over the finite field, define the actual compact-support extension functor, pullback, adjunction, sheafified continuous extension by zero, coefficient-unit normalization, ordinary restriction and inside/outside adic fibre comparisons. These data use exactly [def-a1-adic-section-canonical-models], [def-a1-finite-adic-ordinary-section-data].
